schema.name: validate_table
schema.description: Validate EVERY original CSV/TSV record to EOF before filtering or deduplication. For explicitly supplied table inputs, original validation is required before Python, Shell or sub-agent execution. Inspect headers/samples with read_file first. Completion also verifies final input state. Provide fields for ALL columns using the task's rules: text/integer/decimal/date(YYYY-MM-DD)/boolean(true,false)/enum. Required by default; use nullable=true only when allowed. Decimal is finite and supports minimum/maximum as strings and scale. Enum requires explicit values. Schema is locked after a scan, including failures. Default profile='declared_fields' uses the task's actual rules; column names never select domain rules. Explicit profile='transaction_v1' for matching order/refund tasks enforces required IDs, revision integer minimum>=1, amount decimal minimum>=0 scale<=2, status/region/currency enums, date as date and is_test as boolean when present; these checks cannot be weakened to text or nullable. Other tables use the declared rules. Inputs must stay unchanged by default. Only for a user-requested in-place edit/append, declare source_mode='edit_target' for that file BEFORE its first scan and before writing. This role is locked per file. Scan the full original first, then rescan the full edited version; final edited data must be valid. For schema edits, declare output_fields alongside the original fields before the first scan; both contracts are locked. Omit fields on later scans to inherit the applicable contract. For user-requested whole-file replacement without processing old records, first declare replace_target with the final fields, then replace and validate the full new file. For deletion, first declare delete_target without fields, then delete through an authorized writer. For rename/move, first scan ALL original data with source_mode='move_target', fields and destination_path naming a different, absent destination. That destination is locked. Then use an authorized writer to move the file without changing its bytes. Completion requires the original path to be absent, the destination to be readable without changed symlinks, its full hash to match the original scan, and all original data checks to pass for the declared purpose. Copying, changing content or skipping validation does not suffice. Deletion/replacement preparation calls return operation_ready, not data-validation evidence; completion checks the actual final file state. Roles never authorize a write. Returns hashes, full row and field counts, and at most 20 error samples. Declare purpose='diagnosis' BEFORE the first scan only when the task is to inspect/report data errors; otherwise use 'computation' (initial default). Purpose is locked for the run; omitted later calls inherit it. For scan calls, success/validation_complete mean the scan finished; data_valid reports data quality separately. A complete diagnosis may finish with data_valid=false; computation still requires valid input. Both require every input/field, EOF and hashes matching the validated version. Report all required findings and deliver/read back requested diagnostic artifacts. This validates source data, not the correctness of output calculations.

profile.description: Explicit domain contract, locked with fields. Default declared_fields follows the user's actual rules. Choose transaction_v1 only for tasks requiring its order/refund constraints, never from column names alone. Omit later calls to inherit.

source_mode.description: Declare before any file operation; role is locked. input is immutable. edit_target validates original and final data. replace_target prepares a user-requested whole-file replacement without processing old records: fields describes the required final schema. delete_target prepares a user-requested deletion without parsing data or fields. move_target requires a full original scan with fields and a locked destination_path before moving unchanged bytes. These declarations do not authorize writes. Omit later calls to inherit.

destination_path.description: Only for move_target: declare a different, absent destination before the first scan. Locked with the contract; omit later calls to inherit. Does not perform or authorize a move.

purpose.description: Task purpose, fixed before the first scan. Omit to inherit; initially computation. Diagnosis only inspects/reports data errors, not calculations requiring valid input.

output_fields.description: Only for edit_target: declare a different final schema with the original fields before the first scan. Both schemas are locked; later scans use the final schema. Omit fields on later calls to inherit the applicable schema.
